description: Aggregated readiness review for the future renderer implementation slice (007H+). This is a spec-only fixture; no React, no IPC, no runtime. It captures the reviewed slices, the recommended component implementation order, the gates that must be enforced, the blockers identified, and the explicit go / no-go decision.

reviewed_slices.title: UI copy deck + golden UI fixtures

component_order.rationale: Leaf component; pure presentational; easiest to test in isolation; smallest surface area
Leaf component; pure presentational; mirrors GateCard structure; testable in isolation
Composed panel; depends on projectRequestToSummary only; no internal state
Composed panel; renders 3 lists from request; no internal state
Composed panel; renders 3 bucket sections from bucketReport prop
Holds interactive controls (phrase input, risks checkbox, Confirm Flush, Reject); uses dispatch; orchestrates enablement via computeConfirmButtonEnabled
Top-level container; owns the reducer state; composes the other 6 components; last to implement because it depends on all others
